claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Pantoprazole at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent; its only plausible antiproliferative effect is weak inhibition of vacuolar H+-ATPase-mediated extracellular acidification, which is unlikely to kill cells at this concentration.
